name: Sukhoi Su 57 Felon P Fighter Jet Free

operating_principle: The Su-57 is a twin-engine stealth multirole fighter aircraft that uses thrust vectoring nozzles and advanced flight control systems to achieve high maneuverability and departure resistance. It is designed with stealth technology to reduce its radar cross-section.
